action_description: a heavy close-range hammer smash: he heaves the giant hammer up from the ground over his head with both paws, holds for a moment at the top, then slams it down hard onto the ground right in front of him with a burst of dust and small rocks, then drags it back to rest. Slow wind-up, very fast strike, the fur mantle swings. Side view facing right in every frame, do not turn toward the camera, same size.
